_about: Normal-rarity (white) base items targeted by Chance Orbs for chase uniques in POE2.
_notes: Sourced from Maxroll's 0.5.0 'Return of the Ancients' Best-to-Chance guide and POE2TOOLS' top-10 value tracker (verified Jun 2026).
IMPORTANT: only NORMAL bases can be chanced — Advanced/Expert variants of the same base CANNOT.

Every entry here is verified to be a real POE2 base item name. The tablet entries from POE2TOOLS' article ('Precursor Tablet', 'Abyss Precursor Tablet') turned out NOT to be real POE2 base names — those were the article's category labels, and using them in BaseType breaks the filter parser. They have been removed.
Boss-locked uniques cannot be chanced (e.g. Astramentis from Stellar Amulet is chanceable; others may not be).
The meta shifts patch-to-patch and as supply changes. Treat this list as a curated baseline.
Edit `enabled` to include/exclude a base from the in-filter section.
When adding a new base, double-check the EXACT in-game spelling — POE2 will reject the filter if a BaseType references a base it doesn't recognise.
Re-run Tools -> 'Add/Update Chance Orb Items' after editing to regenerate the section.
